title: Misty Echo test portal and Dan Burisch's S4 story
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Misty Echo test portal and Dan Burisch's S4 story, about 1988 at Nevada test site and Area 51, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: even have this misty echo patch around a test from 1988. And it looks like there's a portal underground. And that would explain the Dan Barish story of S4 Area 51.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, describes a patch, a cloth badge, made for Misty Echo, a 1988 underground test at the government's test site in Nevada, and says its design looks like it shows a portal underground. Michels says this would fit the story told by Dan Burisch, a man who claims to know of secret work at S4, a site said to be near Area 51, the closely guarded military base in Nevada. If so, the patch would hint that something like a doorway was part of that secret work.
